definitions.explanation: A professional who takes photographs or films video. Unlike English "cameraman," the Japanese word covers both still photographers and video camera operators of any gender.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はプロのカメラマンだ。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}のカメラマンを{雇|やと}った。
examples.english: We hired a photographer for the wedding.

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}カメラマンとして{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{紛争地|ふんそうち}を{取材|しゅざい}してきた。
examples.english: As a news photographer, he has covered conflict zones around the world.

notes:
A wasei-eigo coinage ("Japanese-made English"). The word is gender-neutral in Japanese despite ending in -マン.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {報道|ほうどう}カメラマン: news photographer
- {ファッション|ふぁっしょん}カメラマン: fashion photographer
- {スポーツ|すぽーつ}カメラマン: sports photographer
- プロカメラマン: professional photographer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {写真家|しゃしんか}: photographer — used for artistic/fine-art photographers
- フォトグラファー: photographer — newer loanword, similar to カメラマン but slightly more upmarket
- {撮影|さつえい}{監督|かんとく}: director of photography (film)
